definitions: It is up to you to make the next decision or take the next action.
It is your responsibility to act now.
examples: I've done all I can; the ball is in your court now.
We've presented our offer, so the ball is in their court.
The project is complete on our end, the ball is in your court to launch it.
lemma: the ball is in your court
source: the ball is in your court
